events: GPU MODE's TriMul task opens (triangular multiplicative update from AlphaFold 3). Every GPU type has its own leaderboard: A100, H100, B200, MI300X; the score is the geometric mean runtime over 7 input shapes.
TTT-Discover (arXiv:2601.16175) reports 914.2 µs on B200 against 1038.9 µs for the best human kernel. It trained on H100 runtime only and could not submit B200 results to the board.
The 'TTT' account submits an H100 kernel to the official board (paper: 1161.2 µs; today's board shows 1189.7 µs, rank 6).
K-Search (arXiv:2602.19128) reaches 1030 µs on H100 with GPT-5.2 + Gemini-3-Pro (300 iterations). It reports no TriMul number on B200.
The competition closes on 2026-05-09. The B200 board ends with josusanmartin at 553.982 µs (rank 1) and shiyegao at 554.395 µs (rank 2).
